context_summary: F06 REST API — plan-feature (PLAN_ONLY, Architect only). The project is ready for its next phase: exposing collected data via a REST API. All prerequisites are in place: F01-F05 shipped (213 tests, 97% coverage, 0 lint errors), ADR-0002 proposes FastAPI with detailed rationale, docs/API.md contains a complete endpoint specification (cards, sets, market movers, stats, admin collection triggers), and the roadmap identifies Phase 4 (REST API) as the next milestone. The existing codebase is async-first (curl_cffi, pytest-asyncio) and SQLAlchemy-based, both of which align well with FastAPI. No new dependencies have been introduced without review. No blockers identified.

options_considered.description: Proceed with plan-feature (Architect only, PLAN_ONLY). Let the Architect decompose F06 into tasks and waves based on the existing API.md spec and ADR-0002.
pros: All prerequisites satisfied: stable codebase, ADR approved, full API spec written
PLAN_ONLY mode is low-risk — produces task files without code changes
Async-first codebase aligns perfectly with FastAPI's async-native design
API.md provides clear, bounded scope for the Architect to decompose
Phase 4 is the natural next step per the project roadmap
cons: Adds a new dependency (fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic) — but this was already decided in ADR-0002
API scope is broad (7 endpoints + envelope + pagination + error handling) — Architect must decompose carefully into incremental waves

options_considered.description: Defer F06. Address additional tech debt or expand analytics before building the API.
pros: More data collection time means richer API responses at launch
cons: No concrete tech debt remains — F05 cleaned it to 97% coverage
The API is the critical path to the front-end (noted in Future Planning)
Deferring without a reason wastes the planning work already done in API.md and ADR-0002
No blockers exist — deferral is unjustified

options_considered.description: Proceed with full create-feature (plan + execute) in a single decision.
pros: Faster delivery — no separate execution decision needed
cons: The request explicitly asks for PLAN_ONLY mode
F06 is the largest feature yet (new framework, 7+ endpoints, Pydantic models, middleware) — planning first is prudent
Reviewing the plan before execution allows scope validation

rationale: F06 is the natural next feature per the roadmap, and the project is fully ready. ADR-0002 (FastAPI) provides the architectural foundation. docs/API.md provides a complete, bounded endpoint specification. The codebase is stable at 97% coverage with zero lint errors. No tech debt or blockers remain. PLAN_ONLY mode is appropriate for a feature of this scope — it lets the Architect decompose the 7-endpoint API into incremental waves, which can be reviewed before committing to execution. Proceeding with Option A.
